title: LinkedIn Lead Discovery MCP
headline: Discover companies, candidate people and LinkedIn research evidence in your AI client.
summary: A 24-tool Typenode-hosted LinkedIn discovery suite using curated Apify scrapers, owner-controlled collection budgets and recoverable result paging.
description: Search companies and people, inspect known profiles, retrieve jobs/posts/activity and collect independent account or post-engagement datasets. The AI client owns qualification and interpretation. No LinkedIn messages, connection requests, publishing, CRM writes or inferred intent.
first_use_prompts: Find candidate people matching a role and location I supply, using the configured default budget unless I supply a lower cap.
Given these website domains, find candidate LinkedIn company pages and leave ambiguous matches unresolved.
Read the next page of a previous collection without starting another scrape.
prerequisites: Typenode Workspace with access to the hosted template when available; normal account/billing rules apply.
Customer-owned Apify account, usable billing/usage allowance and access to the selected providers.
Apify API token configured securely in Typenode with required collection and result-reading access.
AI client supporting an authenticated Typenode remote MCP endpoint.
Owner-configured default and hard USD caps; allow_budget_override defaults false. Explicit child budgets for selected batch/preset datasets.

applications.description: Collect supported LinkedIn source data and read existing run/dataset evidence.

configuration_requirements.description: Secure Typenode configuration using the customer-owned Apify token. Required operations include starting qualified collections and reading run metadata, original input, pricing evidence and dataset items; configure supported permissions rather than assuming an empty scope list means unrestricted or no access.

schema.description: Required owner-selected per-invocation budget when max_cost_usd is omitted. No universal numeric default.
Required owner-selected absolute per-invocation ceiling, including all child acquisitions; cannot exceed this catalog's $10 bound.
Owner-only permission to request a cap above the default, up to the hard ceiling. Lower request budgets are always allowed.

configuration_requirements.description: Fresh stable installation UUID; change when switching accounts.
Apify account ID verified through authenticated identity access.

configuration_schema.title: Owner-controlled acquisition budget policy
configuration_schema.description: Installation configuration, never MCP tool arguments. Default must not exceed hard ceiling; validate this relation and finite values before paid work. Amounts exclude separately billed Typenode usage.

default_max_cost_usd.description: Required owner-selected per-invocation budget when max_cost_usd is omitted. No universal numeric default.

hard_max_cost_usd.description: Required owner-selected absolute per-invocation ceiling, including all child acquisitions; cannot exceed this catalog's $10 bound.

allow_budget_override.description: Owner-only permission to request a cap above the default, up to the hard ceiling. Lower request budgets are always allowed.

mcp_server.name: LinkedIn Lead Discovery
mcp_server.description: Bounded LinkedIn discovery and evidence retrieval through Apify; paid collections are distinct from reading existing results.

success_criteria: All 24 tools freshly discoverable through the intended client.
Every advertised tool has positive live evidence on the deployed public contract.
Invalid plans fail before paid starts; observed provider charge caps match authorisation.
Pending/run recovery and collected-result continuation do not silently repeat acquisitions.
Independent installation, client renewal and provider reconnect/revocation paths verified.
notes: Built and tested in a maintainer installation; independent latest-snapshot customer installation remains unverified.
All 24 tools have live smoke evidence; this is not universal client or independent installation qualification.
Source access is read-only toward LinkedIn, but collections create Apify runs/datasets and can incur costs.
The qualified providers use the configured Apify token; no LinkedIn browser session is required by this template.
Application/authentication identifiers match the reviewed current catalog.
